item.description: Fix missing imports for SwitchValue, DuplicateElaboratable, and MemoryData classes
item.contract: The SwitchValue, DuplicateElaboratable, and MemoryData classes should be properly imported and exported from the main hdl module to resolve NameError exceptions in failing tests.
item.acceptance: Tests such as tests/test_hdl_ir.py::AssignTestCase::test_switchvalue, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::DuplicateElaboratableTestCase::test_duplicate, tests/test_lib_memory.py::MemoryTestCase::test_constructor, and tests/test_lib_memory.py::MemoryTestCase::test_constructor_shapecastable should pass
